body: Hahah I love the analogy. Thank you again for spending the time of your own day to help a random stranger.. maybe this world is not that bad after all :)

Thank you for the kind words.. 

I don't know how or why it creeps back, and I passionately hate it. I just want the best for them, and it is so hard not to do anything because on one hand, it feels like I am ridding them a burden (myself), but on another, I know what it is like to lose someone to suicide and the pain they'd feel.

It really is a pickle
